reason: The cited evidence confirms the phase composition and σ-phase disappearance in APS CoCrFeNiMo coatings (E4) and that the study aims to analyze wear resistance (E2), but no evidence supports high-temperature performance up to 800 °C or application on a CoCrFeNi matrix, leaving key premises unsupported.
